offer: Beauty Moguls runs a $10K coaching program that helps PMU artists and beauty, spa and aesthetics business owners get clients with paid ads. Ad spend of about $600-900 per month is paid separately, on top of the program, and the owner commits about 5 hours per week. Skepticism, or saying they have been burned by an agency or program before, is normal for these buyers and is NOT a negative signal for any category.
speakers: Two speakers: a setter from Beauty Moguls and a prospect. Speaker labels are numbers; tell them apart from context.

categories.label: Biz Fit
categories.topic: what kind of business they run and whether it is currently active
categories.rate: how well the prospect's business fits the program
levels: Outside the beauty industry, or no active business
Adjacent beauty business; fit needs review
Active PMU artist, or owner of a beauty, spa or aesthetics business

categories.label: Monthly Rev
categories.topic: how much money their business makes per month
levels: Below $4K per month
Between $4K and $8K per month, or the amount is unclear
Confirmed $8K per month or more (any amount above that is still this level)

categories.label: Problem & Goals
categories.topic: a problem in their business or a goal they want to reach
categories.rate: how clear and relevant the prospect's problem and goals are. Ignore timing; it is rated separately
levels: No relevant need
General interest in growth
A clear client-acquisition or consistency problem with a specific goal

categories.label: Timeline
categories.topic: when they want to fix their problem or start
categories.rate: how soon the prospect needs a solution
levels: No timeline, or not a priority
Vague timeline, such as "eventually" or "sometime this year"
Needs it now or within 90 days

categories.label: Investment Readiness
categories.topic: the program's price, or whether they can pay for the program
categories.rate: the prospect's readiness to pay for the program itself, not ad spend
levels: Says the program is financially out of reach
Unclear, or needs discussion
Understands the $10K program cost and confirms they can pay it

categories.label: Ad-Spend Capacity
categories.topic: a monthly budget for ads, separate from the program price
categories.rate: the prospect's ability to fund a monthly ad budget on top of the program
levels: Cannot commit a monthly ad budget
Unclear
Confirms about $600-900 per month for ads on top of the program

categories.label: Decision & Implementation
categories.topic: who makes the buying decision, or whether they have time to do the work
categories.rate: the prospect's decision authority and readiness to put in the time
levels: Is not the decision-maker, or cannot commit the time
Will have to check with someone else first, or timing is unclear
Makes the decision alone (or others are not involved) and is ready for about 5 hours per week

categories.label: Behavior/Engagement
levels: Bounced fast, never played the VSL, form abandoned
Partial VSL watch or incomplete form
Completed form, past the gate, and/or repeat visits

dq_no_revenue.instructions: In `call_transcript`, does the prospect say their business has no clients at all, or no revenue at all?

dq_magic_button.reason: Wants a "just turn on ads" fix
dq_magic_button.instructions: In `call_transcript`, does the prospect expect results without doing any work themselves, for example wanting someone to "just turn on ads" or a magic button?

tag_academy.label: Academy / adding artists
tag_academy.instructions: In `call_transcript`, does the prospect mention starting or growing an academy or training program, or adding artists or staff to their business?
